rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the concerns of my colleagues regarding the 8.70% food inflation, I maintain that this is primarily a supply-side phenomenon that monetary policy is ill-equipped to address. With core inflation having moderated significantly to 4.10%, the real policy rate is now firmly in positive territory, providing sufficient restraint. Continuing with a 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance risks over-tightening and unnecessarily constraining the 6.50% GVA growth trajectory. A shift to a 'neutral' stance better reflects the current macroeconomic reality where the repo rate is already at an appropriate level to guide inflation toward the 4% target without stifling the recovery.
